units: uu, UE axes (X forward, Y right, Z up); origin at ground level centred between the axles
wheel_outer_face: W01 mesh is authored with its show face on Blender +Y (= UE -Y, left). Left wheels (FL, RL) as-is; right wheels (FR, RR) yaw 180 deg.
wheel_wobble_note: spec 4b rule 3: tiny per-wheel camber/toe imperfection, cosmetic only (apply to the wheel mesh component, not to physics)

wheel_arch.note: toy ride height; the wheel may travel ~2.5 uu up before touching the arch

stance.note: body, base, windows and interior meshes are already pitched nose-down by rake_deg about the axle line; do not add it again

heads.note: peened steel heads sit in the W01 hub bores; keep wheel centres at the sidecar positions (no visual suspension travel), or they float

base_band.note: black plastic band visible under the body sill in side view (spec 4b rule 4). Rev 5: behind the rear wheels it is only a thin lip (z 2.0-4.4 visible, tucked ~1.2 uu under the body-colour rear bumper) with one bare-zamac exhaust tip (Col R); there is no black rear bumper any more - the body paint wraps the tail down to z 4.4 (spec 4b rule 11)

slot_use.Paint: the whole casting incl. cast lamp bosses, grille grooves, mirror nubs and the roof lamp bar (lamps/grille are coloured by the tampo)

feature.note: engraved rounded-rectangle panel on the roof between the roof scoop and the spoiler; mask it in M_ToyPaint with panel_uv1_rect (u0,v0,u1,v1); the tampo leaves it clear

rally_lamps.note: pods on a bar cast into the roof front; they stand above the 40 uu hitbox (visual only)

headlamps.type: cast bosses printed by the tampo (silver bezel, white main lamp, yellow driving lamp)

tail_lamps.type: cast bosses printed by the tampo (dark-red rim, red lens, amber indicator outer end, white reverse inner end); rev 5: printed plate (cream, black border, 'OF 91') between them, rev 10: on the top face of a raised 0.3 uu cast plate boss; cast body-colour rear bumper below

vertex_color.Body: Col on the Lamp slot: amber (1,0.70,0.16) = rally lamps; white elsewhere. Multiply the Lamp colour by it
vertex_color.Base: Col: R = steel axles + peened heads, G = rivet heads, black = moulded black plastic base

uv.UV0: smart unwrap per part, non-overlapping (wear / grain masks)
uv.UV1: tampo layout in the un-raked casting frame (uniform scale 0.5/120 per uu): left side U0-0.5 V0-0.2 (front at U0, as seen from the left), right side U0.5-1 V0-0.2 (front at U1), top strip U0-0.5 V0.65-1 (U rear->front from x=-58.5, V = 1-(42-y)/240), front island U0.55-0.9 V0.25-0.445 (U from the car's right to left, V by height), rear island U0.55-0.9 V0.45-0.645 (U from left to right as seen from behind), inside/underside parked in U0.92-1 V0.92-1

paint.name: Streak Blue metallic
paint.finish: metallic enamel, fine visible flake, mild orange-peel gloss clearcoat (coat roughness ~0.025)

tampo.design: 1991 rally-hatch: white side band with yellow + red pinstripes (italic cut), red-ringed white door roundel with a knocked-out '7', red 'S' casting badge on the C-pillar, white twin bonnet stripes with red pinstripes, printed silver/white/yellow headlamps, black grille, red/amber/white tail lamps with a dark-red rim, cream rear plate printed 'OF 91' with a black border
tampo.flaws: 0.3-0.5 uu per-ink registration offsets, wobbly edges, density variation, pinholes, thin print in the door grooves
tampo.blend: alpha = ink coverage; ink is matte-ish (roughness ~0.4, clearcoat reduced), metal_mask R = metallic silver ink

interior.name: charcoal
interior.note: rev 9: tub clipped by the true cabin field (front seat backs and wheel rim whole), cast-in wheel = rim over a dished disc; rev 8: mid-dark charcoal one-colour tub (spec 4b rule 13) with rear side trim + arch humps, a quarter-window trim panel and a widened rear bench, = INTERIORS['Charcoal'] in Tools/Assembly/import_castings.py (OldFaithful interior='Charcoal')

windows.note: light-smoke clear plastic; the interior must stay clearly visible

base_decal_area.note: recessed plain panel on the underside for a decal

export: FBX per part, Blender metres at game scale (1 m = 100 uu), axis_forward X, axis_up Z
source: SourceArt/Blender/HatchlingS/build_HatchlingS.py (rev 10: Opus rear pass 5b - one-piece rear quarter (long C2 flare taper, one hip roll), capped tailgate lines, raised plate boss, softer tail notch, local refinement of the tail / notch / side-pane bottoms; rev 9: Opus rear pass 5 - one-crown shoulder (no badge double image), straight-drop tail corners with a rear notch + open rear wells (axle stub visible at 3/4-rear axle height), tailgate lines into the bumper ledge, soft door/bonnet lines, flat window panes, true-cabin interior; r5 spike/notch gate 0 on every part)

export_pipeline.normals: authored (computed after cleanup; import normals, do not recompute)
